NAME: Kober
NOTES: Two stones with unknown information were recorded. This is a possible location based on description, and should not be taken as fact.

NAME: Abner-McCarty
NOTES: Two known graves, plus 25 stones with unknown information. This is a possible location based on the description  (NW Section 21, Brookville Township) and a map from 1867 which places a cemetery at this location on land owned by W. Liveley.

NAME: Grace Stout
NOTES: Eleven graves are recorded, six of which were from the Logan Family. Some sources indicate that only the six Logan burials were present. It was located just off of Battle Point.

NAME: Gavin
NOTES: Five known graves, plus 16 stones with unknown information. This is a possible location based on 1867 map which listed this land as owned by D.H. Gavin. This location should not be taken as fact.

NAME: Old Templeton
NOTES: 36 known graves, plus 26 stones with unknown information. It was also recorded as having 59 total graves. It was located on the farm of a man named Speedy.

NAME: Dickerson
NOTES: Seven known graves, plus seven or eight stones with unknown information. It was located on an old farm hill road on Earl G.'s farm.

NAME: Barrickman
NOTES: Three known graves, plus 17 stones with unknown information. Located on an old farm hill road on land owned by A.D. Notes indicate that it was possibly a native burial location.

NAME: Brier
NOTES: Sources differ on the number of interments, with one placing it at 237 and another at 376. It was located at the south end of the town of Fairfield.

NAME: Leviston and Templeton
NOTES: Six or seven graves were recorded depending on source. It was located to the south of Dunlapsville, on the east side of the river.

NAME: Harrell
NOTES: Four known graves. It was located on the west side of the river.

NAME: Sims
NOTES: Between 779 and 880 graves recorded based on source. It was located north of Fairfield.

NAME: Jonas
NOTES: This cemetery contained one unmarked grave of both Wendall and Barbara Luker with no dates on it. This is an approximate location based only on descriptions and should not be taken as fact.
